notes.title: Point Perfect now on Mac!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/We1K0yU.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 

It was a bit unfair that only PC players were able to meet awesome boss, be trolled by the game and die a thousand times, so the game is now available to Mac users!

Have fun, and don't hesitate to contact us for any issue with this Mac build!

notes.title: Update Steam version 1.3.2
notes.notes:
I finally got around to fixing the bugs. Thanks to all the Point Perfect fans and I'm sorry for the wait. Here is a summary:

- Achievements are now working properly.
- Fixed a glitch that can sometimes happen with the bomb item.
- Fixed rare trophy glitch.
- Point Perfect now supports Steam Screenshots!

Balance:

- None. (You didn't think I would make it easier did you?)

notes.title: Golden Mouse Winner! + Contest Extension
notes.notes:
We would like to congratulate our winner LootZ from Switzerland for being the first player to complete the Golden Mouse Challenge! LootZ will take home the Golden Mouse Trophy and has earned supreme bragging rights.

 We do understand that there are a lot of people who have come very close and so Highcastle Studios is going to extend the contest! For a limited time we will be awarding Golden Mouse Certificates to gamers that can complete this hardcore challenge. The certificate will be signed and mailed to you! Same rules apply.

Thanks for playing and good luck!

notes.title: Golden Mouse Champion Contest!
notes.notes:
So what is the Golden Mouse? Think of it as the World Cup of mouse control! The first player to unlock all of the in-game trophies will be immortalised as the Golden Mouse Champion! Check out the official facebook page for the rules and some pictures of the trophy. Good luck pilot!
https://www.facebook.com/pointperfectgamer?ref_type=bookmark
